title: Edit an active Space checklist collection
outcome: Open an isolated draft for one represented active Project or Business Inventory Space, edit its complete checklist structure and text, then cancel without mutation or save one durable revision-bound replacement with conflict recovery.

uiJourneys.targetPage: Target exact-Space detail and isolated checklist editor

controls.label: Edit

options.label: Open editor
options.result: Copies the represented active Space checklist hierarchy into an isolated stable-identity draft.

controls.action: Tap Edit in the expanded CHECKLISTS section.
controls.result: The editor opens only from complete represented active-Space evidence and performs no write.

controls.label: Checklist Name / Item text

options.label: Edit text
options.result: Changes only the local draft while preserving checklist and item identity.

controls.action: Edit any represented checklist name or item text.
controls.result: No command is accepted until Save; canonical target validation owns submitted text.

controls.label: Item checkbox

options.label: Checked / unchecked
options.result: Changes draft checked state and draft progress without invoking the immediate-toggle workflow.

controls.action: Toggle an item inside the editor.
controls.result: Only the draft changes until Save.

controls.label: Add Item / Add Checklist

options.label: Add Item
options.result: Appends one stable-ID draft item to its checklist.

options.label: Add Checklist
options.result: Appends one stable-ID draft checklist that may contain zero items.

controls.action: Add checklist structure in the editor.
controls.result: New identities and order are frozen in the draft and included only if saved.

controls.label: Delete / swipe delete

options.label: Delete Checklist
options.result: Removes that checklist and its draft items.

controls.result: Deletion remains local until one complete replacement is saved.

controls.label: Reorder

options.label: Move Item
options.result: Changes item presentation order within its checklist without changing stable identity.

controls.result: The saved complete hierarchy contains unique canonical presentation order.

controls.label: Save

options.label: Ready
options.result: Accepts exactly one full replacement bound to the represented Space revision, then shows pending state until authoritative settlement.

options.label: Saving / conflict
options.result: Prevents duplicate submission and preserves actionable draft/conflict evidence.

controls.result: Durable local acceptance precedes optimistic detail projection; rejection never silently discards the user's draft.

options.label: Discard draft
options.result: Dismisses the editor and dispatches no operation.

transitions.to: Actionable conflict draft eligible for explicit retry

states.name: Waiting, incomplete, unavailable, absent, or archived detail
states.expected: Edit cannot open and Save cannot dispatch.

states.name: Empty collection
states.expected: Editor can add a checklist or save the complete empty collection when it represents a semantic change.

states.name: Zero-item checklist
states.expected: Checklist remains valid and may receive an item later.

states.name: Queued or applying save
states.expected: Draft result remains visible, duplicate Save is disabled, and pending state survives restart.

states.name: Rejected or revision-conflicted save
states.expected: Unsupported optimism settles only against refreshed complete detail and the actionable draft is not silently lost.

acceptanceChecks.expected: Open, every catalogued draft action, Cancel, Save, pending, rejection and readback traverse one shared complete-replacement workflow.
Every claimed editor control, disabled rule, transition, empty state, conflict state and accessibility identity is compiled and interaction-tested.
Save reuses atomic encrypted acceptance, exact replay, restart restoration, rejection recovery and authoritative readback without duplicate commands.
Only exact represented Space and operation evidence can settle the editor save; stale, foreign, malformed and incomplete evidence fails closed.

deferredBehaviors: The duplicate Space Options launcher is not claimed by this bounded section workflow.
Space name/notes, completion, templates, media, Items/placement, archive and accounting are separate workflows.
Hosted authenticated Supabase/PowerSync upload and revocation proof remains gated by A-003/A-004.

review.summary: Review will focus on draft preservation, exact text and identity semantics, duplicate admission, conflict recovery, and complete catalog control coverage.
